caseNameFull: Nelms v. United States and Dow, aka Corey v. Attorney General of the United States
attorneys: Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Vinson and Beatrice Rosenberg for the United States, in opposition in both cases.

opinions.text:
Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
